about.title: About Cash & Forbes Insurance Group
text: Cash & Forbes Insurance Group began as an independent insurance agency in 2018 by two agents who had similar ideals and goals in mind to better serve the needs of their clients. With nearly two decades of insurance experience each, owners Chris Forbes and Charles Cash are excited to work with you.

Cash & Forbes Insurance Group is an independent insurance agency, and that’s important for more reasons than one. It allows us to help you find insurance from a variety of coverage options. It is also part of who we are and where we’ve been—owners Chris Forbes and Charles Cash were captive agents before going independent to better serve the people and families of Texas.

Since our start in 2018, we bring decades of combined experience and a team that’s ready to help each and every client. We’ve also been focused on growth to allow more capacity to serve you, merging with Memorial Insurance Agency and adding another office location. Above all, we carry on the founding principles of facts first, honesty and integrity, and providing quick, reliable responses you can count on.
